Addendum to the dev report 7219690738 (PR #37971), 2026-11-27T13:39Z.

Premise corrected: card #37307 item 3 ("follow the refuse-or-warn verdict the `ai_context` row took") conflicts with ADR-0161 K4; K4 wins, so this rule is `gating` at publish (refuses), not advisory. Seat 1 ruling on this PR: keep gating.
Ruling-ref: `docs/adr/0161-knowledge-platform-boundary-platform-owns-assembly-sync-split-record-return-knowledge-source-is-a-governed-type.md` K4 — "It defines no object, extends none, and is refused when the object or a named field does not exist (the lint and `os validate` checks are row 4)." and "An object whose package is disabled, that the API exposure refuses for search, or that is a system object without `enable.aiReadable`, and a field the author may not query, each refuse the save with a coded refusal that names the object or the field. A packaged item meets the gates that need no principal in `os validate` and at publish (row 4)."

The PR body carries the same two lines.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwoXEE1amuRAGHdPBs

Seat ruling · 2026-11-27T15:14Z · card #37307 item 3 (refuse-or-warn at publish) · PR #37971

Premise corrected: item 3 says "Follow the refuse-or-warn verdict the `ai_context` row took and state it". Where that would make the publish door warn, it conflicts with an accepted ruling, and the ruling governs.
Ruling-ref: `docs/adr/0161-knowledge-platform-boundary-platform-owns-assembly-sync-split-record-return-knowledge-source-is-a-governed-type.md` K4 (on `main`, accepted by merge): an item "is refused when the object or a named field does not exist (the lint and `os validate` checks are row 4)"; at save the gates "each refuse the save with a coded refusal that names the object or the field. A packaged item meets the gates that need no principal in `os validate` and at publish (row 4)."

So the publish door GATES (refuses) on these checks; it does not take the `ai_context` row's advisory verdict. This applies an existing ruling and is not a new behaviour ruling, so no decision box. The narrowing the PR declares lands as Tier H through this seat (L1 + same-head contract review, seat record, authorised approval).
